## What this changes

- [ ] a new episode in `episodes/<id>/` (only files inside that folder, plus one line in `.github/CODEOWNERS`)
- [ ] a fix to an existing episode (owner approval needed)
- [ ] shared tools or docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/check_episodes.py` passes locally
- [ ] every number in the world has a source tag (P primary, R retelling, E our estimate) and a link
- [ ] no copied game, no real company brands, no personal data
- [ ] predictions for model runs were written before the runs (`PREDICTIONS.md` in the episode)
